guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Create your MINT account
guide.description: Register on the MINT website . An account is required before any play counts toward Season 1 XP.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Fund your MINT wallet
guide.description: Deposit USDT, USDC or ETH into your MINT wallet on one of the supported networks. Make sure the network selected on MINT matches the one used by your sending wallet or exchange, since deposits sent over the wrong network can be lost. Alternatively, you can pick up any of these assets directly through the Mint cashier tab cash on-ramp.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Play casino games and sportsbook markets
guide.description: Every eligible play earns Season 1 XP. You need at least $50 wagered cumulatively to qualify for the airdrop, so smaller regular sessions count just as much as one large bet.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Climb the XP leaderboard
guide.description: Your XP sets your position on the live leaderboard. A higher rank at the snapshot means a larger potential share of the $125,000 pool. Qualifying referrals, available boosts and selected quests add XP on top of your own play.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Keep earning XP until the snapshot
guide.description: The Season 1 snapshot happens shortly before the TGE in Q4 2026, with the exact date announced through MINT’s official channels. Your verified XP at that moment locks in your allocation.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim and stake your $MNTD
guide.description: At TGE, claim your allocation through the rewards section on mint.io. You can then stake your $MNTD to activate MINT Status, earn compounded staking rewards and start moving up the levels.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Create Your PayBox Account
guide.description: Go to PayBox and sign up with your email. You do not need a MoonPay account. Pick Claude or ChatGPT as your assistant and copy the connector URL: https://api.paybox.sh/mcp
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Add the PayBox Connector to Your AI Assistant
guide.description: The setup differs slightly per platform: ChatGPT: On the ChatGPT website (Developer mode is unavailable in the mobile app), open Settings, enable Developer mode under Security, then go to Plugins, select New Plugin, name it PayBox, paste the server URL, and set Authentication to OAuth. Claude: Select “Open Claude Settings” from the PayBox site, and the connector should appear pre-filled; select “A
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Authorize PayBox With a Passkey
guide.description: Save the connector, select Connect, and complete the OAuth authorization. Register a passkey when prompted. PayBox then creates a Solana wallet and an EVM wallet for you.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Test the Connection in Chat
guide.description: Start a conversation and ask your assistant “@PayBox check my balance”. Follow the prompts to finish wallet setup and confirm the agent can reach your vault.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Verify Everything on the Dashboard
guide.description: Open the PayBox Dashboard and sign in with your passkey. Your AI platform should be listed under Agents and both wallets under Credentials. If something is missing, reconnect before the faucet goes live.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect X and Claim the USDC Drop
guide.description: Once the faucet reopens, find “Claim your USDC drop” on the dashboard, select Connect X, and authorize your account. Reveal your allocation and the USDC lands in your PayBox Solana wallet. MoonPay has confirmed that users who missed round one will get another chance.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

sourcedSteps.title: Add the PayBox Connector to Your AI Assistant
sourcedSteps.body: The setup differs slightly per platform: ChatGPT: On the ChatGPT website (Developer mode is unavailable in the mobile app), open Settings, enable Developer mode under Security, then go to Plugins, select New Plugin, name it PayBox, paste the server URL, and set Authentication to OAuth. sourcedSteps.body: Open the PayBox Dashboard and sign in with your passkey. Your AI platform should be listed under Agents and both wallets under Credentials. If something is missing, reconnect before the faucet goes live.

sourcedSteps.title: Connect X and Claim the USDC Drop
sourcedSteps.body: Once the faucet reopens, find “Claim your USDC drop” on the dashboard, select Connect X, and authorize your account. Reveal your allocation and the USDC lands in your PayBox Solana wallet. MoonPay has confirmed that users who missed round one will get another chance.

guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Fund a Wallet and Bridge to Ink
guide.description: You need ETH for Ink gas and USDT0 to trade or deposit. Buy ETH and stablecoins on Binance , then move them to the Ink network using the bridge widget below or another bridge that supports Ink. Keep a small ETH balance for transaction fees. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Create Your Nado Account
guide.description: Go to the Nado app and connect an EVM-compatible wallet such as MetaMask or Rabby. Season 2 opened to everyone, so you can sign up directly without a referral code.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Deposit Collateral
guide.description: Send USDT0 to your Nado account to use as margin. The unified margin system lets one balance support multiple spot and perpetual positions, so you do not need separate accounts for each market.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade Spot and Perpetual Markets
guide.description: Open positions across the Nado markets to earn points. Points reward genuine market participation rather than raw volume, so trading, posting limit orders as a maker, and supporting liquidations all count. Wash trading and self-matching can reduce or zero out your allocation for that week.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Provide Liquidity to the NLP Vault
guide.description: Deposit USDT0 into the NLP vault to earn points based on your average proportional share during each weekly epoch. The vault supplies liquidity to the orderbook and earns a cut of trading fees and liquidation proceeds, so you collect yield alongside points.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Use Tokenized Equities as Collateral
guide.description: Deposit SPYx or QQQx to hold spot exposure to US markets while trading from one portfolio. You can also borrow USDT0 against these positions and open BTC, ETH, or SOL perps, since Nado evaluates spot balances, perp positions, and borrowed liabilities under a single portfolio margin. Learn how to deposit xStocks on Nado .
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Refer Active Traders
guide.description: Share your referral link from the Referrals page. You earn referral points only when the people you invite actually trade, so the rewards track real usage rather than sign-ups.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Track Points and Trading Tier
guide.description: Check the points page to monitor your weekly points, ranking, and Trading Tier. Tiers range from Breeze at the bottom to Tornado at the top and influence future NLP eligibility, so consistent weekly activity matters more than a single large session. Full mechanics are in the documentation .
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Connect Your Wallet on the NeoSoul Questboard
guide.description: Go to the NeoSoul Questboard and connect an EVM wallet. Complete the Newbie Tasks to bind your X account, follow the official profile, and join the Telegram and Discord groups. These one-time tasks open up the rest of the point system.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Create an AI Agent on EvoEvo
guide.description: Open EvoEvo , create your agent, and bind its ERC-8004 identity on BNB Smart Chain. This registration needs a small amount of BNB for gas. You can buy BNB on Bybit and withdraw it to BNB Chain, or move funds you already hold using the widget below to bridge or swap into BNB. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interac
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Train Your Agent With Predictions
guide.description: Have your agent predict real-world events, record its reasoning, and assign a confidence score. Once an outcome settles, review the result, keep or reject the reasoning, and add the lesson to your agent’s memory. Consistent prediction and review activity is the main PTS driver on EvoEvo.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete the Daily Questboard Tasks
guide.description: Return to the Questboard for the repeatable daily tasks. They reset on a day-based cycle, so checking in regularly builds PTS steadily over time.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Finish the NeoSoul Quests on Galxe
guide.description: NeoSoul runs a separate quest campaign on Galxe . Open the NeoSoul quest page and complete whatever tasks are active there to earn extra entries and points.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Invite Friends With Your Referral Link
guide.description: Share your referral link from the Questboard. You earn 100 PTS per friend who completes the Newbie Tasks, plus passive PTS from their ongoing activity, and reaching five invites raises your base rate.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: 参与前准备
guide.description: 准备一个专用的独立空投钱包，并确认设备环境安全。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。
guide.done_when: 已创建独立钱包，并记录好助记词（仅离线保存，不输入任何网站）。

guide.title: 进入官方活动页面
guide.description: 点击下方已验证的官方链接。核对浏览器地址栏域名与官网一致后再继续。
guide.done_when: 页面成功打开，且域名与官方一致。

guide.title: 完成核心链上任务
guide.description: 按官方说明完成测试网、积分或交互任务。每一步操作前确认合约地址来源官方。
guide.done_when: 任务状态在官方页面显示为已完成。

guide.title: 检查任务状态
guide.description: 返回官方活动页面，确认所有任务与积分都已正确记录。
guide.done_when: 所有任务均显示已完成，且积分已计入。

guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Open the Nowa Farming Page
guide.description: Go to the Nowa Farming page . Access is invite-only at this stage, so have a code ready before you start. The public code is NOWA.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect Your Wallet
guide.description: Click Connect Wallet and pick your wallet. Nowa supports MetaMask, Trust Wallet, WalletConnect, Phantom, Keplr, Solflare, and Typhon. Sign the connection request when prompted.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Enter Your Invite Code
guide.description: Type NOWA into the invite field. Once accepted, you land on the Nowa Farming dashboard showing your balances, badge tier, and leaderboard rank.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete the Three Mandatory Tasks
guide.description: Farming stays locked until all three are done: Follow Nowa on X and join the Telegram community Invite at least one friend using your personal invite code Click Request Funds to claim your free Devnet-value tokens The Request Funds drop includes NUSC, NOWA, ETH, BTC, BNB, TRX, USDC, USDT, XRP, and SOL, covering every activity in the program without a deposit from you.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade on the Spot Orderbook
guide.description: Place buy and sell orders on the onchain orderbook. Spot volume feeds its own daily bucket and counts toward your leaderboard rank.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Open BNPL Positions
guide.description: Buy an asset through the BNPL flow, post collateral, and settle the balance over time. This is the feature Nowa most wants tested, and it draws from a different daily bucket than spot.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Stake into Vault and Earn
guide.description: Deposit NUSC into the Vault to finance other users’ BNPL positions, then stake into Earn for the second staking bucket. Both accrue NOWA continuously, so funds parked early keep working while you focus elsewhere.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Build Your Referral Tree
guide.description: Share your invite code from the dashboard. Referral activity has its own daily bucket on top of the 10%, 5%, and 2.5% commissions.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

sourcedSteps.title: Visit o1.exchange
sourcedSteps.body: Go to the o1.exchange platform and click “Enter App” on the homepage.

sourcedSteps.title: Create Your Account
sourcedSteps.body: Sign up using your email or connect a Solana wallet. Complete any profile setup steps before moving on.

sourcedSteps.title: Fund Your Wallet with SOL
sourcedSteps.body: You need SOL to trade on the platform. Buy SOL from Binance and transfer it to your Solana wallet, or bridge assets from another network using the bridge widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

sourcedSteps.title: Trade Across Multiple Token Mints
sourcedSteps.body: The allocation formula rewards variety, not just volume. Trade different token pairs across the DEX rather than cycling through the same pair. Holding periods and retention on the platform are also factored in, so don’t just churn trades and leave.

sourcedSteps.title: Access the Rewards Section
sourcedSteps.body: Find the rewards or referral section in the platform menu. Grab your unique referral link and track your S1.1 and S1.2 points from here.

sourcedSteps.title: Refer Active Traders
sourcedSteps.body: Share your referral link with people who will actually use the platform. The formula rewards referral count, so quality referrals who trade consistently contribute more to your allocation than dormant signups.

sourcedSteps.title: Engage on X and Discord
sourcedSteps.body: Social contributions count toward your $O allocation. Participate in o1.exchange’s Discord, pursue the Discord Maxi role if eligible, and engage with the project on X. These signals are part of the formula, not a bonus.

guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Visit the Olympus Aptos claim page
guide.description: Go to the Olympus Aptos page . The claim tab sits directly on the dashboard.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect your wallet
guide.description: Use a wallet such as Petra or Pontem. Approve the connection request when it pops up.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Fund your wallet with a small amount of APT
guide.description: You need APT to cover gas plus the $0.20 anti-sybil fee per claim. You can buy APT on Bybit and withdraw it straight to your Aptos address. If you also plan to use Olympus on its other chains, the widget below lets you bridge or swap funds to the network you need. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim your pOmega and the NFT
guide.description: Open the Claim tab, tap Claim pOmega, and confirm the transaction. You receive 100 pOmega per claim, and early Aptos users get the exclusive NFT on top.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade and predict on the dashboard
guide.description: Put your pOmega to work. Place predictions on open markets, swap tokens, or create a market of your own. Activity across the app is what the quest campaigns track.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Repeat claims during the beta
guide.description: Claims are not capped, so return regularly and claim again. Everything you stack now carries over to the main token later.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Visit the Perpl website
guide.description: Go to the Perpl website .
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect your wallet
guide.description: Click “Connect Wallet” and approve the connection with MetaMask, Rabby, or another EVM wallet.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Fund your wallet with stablecoins
guide.description: Perpl uses AUSD as its collateral asset, but you can start from USDC or USDT. If you need funds, you can buy them on Bybit and withdraw them to your wallet. Open the deposit flow on the Perpl app. If you hold USDC, USDT, or another supported coin, Perpl’s built-in bridge converts it to AUSD during the deposit. A minimum of 10 AUSD is required to open an account.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade perps to earn weekly points
guide.description: Open and close leveraged positions on any listed market. Your organic trading activity earns both Perpl Points and mPoints each week. Snapshots are taken Wednesdays at 16:00 UTC, and points are credited by the following Monday.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Add or generate a referral code
guide.description: Use our referral link for a permanent +5% boost on both Perpl Points and mPoints. Once your own volume passes $10,000, you unlock a personal link that earns 10% of your direct referrals’ fees, 5% from sub-referrals, and a 5% points boost, processed biweekly.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Join the Monad Cards Invitational
guide.description: The $100k Monad Cards Invitational runs until mid-August 2026. Make at least one trade during the tournament period to receive a soulbound badge NFT, and compete on PnL and volume for prizes. Entry is open to Monad Card holders and pre-snapshot Perpl Points holders.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check your balances every Monday
guide.description: Visit the points page and the mPoints tab weekly to confirm your distributions arrived and track your projected MON earnings.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: 完成核心链上任务

guide.done_when: 任务状态在官方页面显示为已完成。

sourcedSteps.title: Claim Your Rewards
sourcedSteps.body: Visit the claim portal and connect your registered wallet to claim your allocation. Season 1 Airdrop Eligibility The Season 1 Airdrop rewards contributors across the Plume ecosystem. Both Early Adopters and Global Community Members had to complete the registration form to qualify for the claim. Early Adopters Testnet Users with Miles: Rewards are distributed above a set threshold on a tier-based system, calculated from Plume Miles, Stamps earned, and airplane mode tasks. Anti-sybil measures apply to protect genuine participants. Active Community Members: Holders of select Plume Discord roles who took part in the testnet campaign. Pre-Deposit Stakers: Users who deposited above a threshold across the three StakeStone and Nest pre-deposit campaigns and held funds until TGE, with rewards proportional to deposit size. The third campaign snapshot was taken January 18 at 5:00 PM UTC. Global Community Members Select RWA and Plume-aligned communities are also included: Polymarket Ondo World Liberty Financial (WLFI) AIXBT by Virtuals Select users of Backed Assets, Dinari, and Swarm X

guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Visit the Push Portal
guide.description: Go to the Push Portal rewards page and log in with a wallet or a social account. If you farmed Season 1 or 2, use the same wallet so your earlier points carry over.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Verify your social accounts
guide.description: Follow PushChain on X and join the Push Chain Discord , then complete verification inside the portal. This unlocks the quest board and referral link.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim testnet PC from the faucet
guide.description: Click the wallet icon inside the portal to open the faucet and claim 1 free PC token. The faucet resets every 6 hours, so grab it a few times a day to keep enough gas for the onchain quests.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete the universal app challenges
guide.description: Work through the quests attached to each app in the weekly rotation: play, or predict, depending on the app. These challenges are the main XP source in Season 3.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check in daily
guide.description: Hit the daily check-in whenever you open the portal. Streaks stack a bonus on top of the base reward, and a missed day resets it.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Use the daily spin
guide.description: The Spin 2 Win wheel pays out Rare Passes, testnet $PC, and other rewards once per day. It takes a few seconds and is one of the few pass sources outside of leveling.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Collect Rare Passes
guide.description: Stack as many Rare Passes as you can through level ups and spins. All passes get burned at TGE for a shot at a Shiny Pass, and the bigger your stash, the better your odds.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Invite friends
guide.description: Share your referral link from the portal. You earn 16% of the points your invites generate and another 8% from the people they invite. Extra invite slots unlock as your referrals reach level 7, so help your invites stay active.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Climb the leaderboard
guide.description: Leaderboards are live and track actual network usage. A higher rank heading into TGE positions you for a larger share of the season allocation.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

sourcedSteps.title: Visit the Push Portal
sourcedSteps.body: Go to the Push Portal rewards page and log in with a wallet or a social account. If you farmed Season 1 or 2, use the same wallet so your earlier points carry over.

sourcedSteps.title: Verify your social accounts
sourcedSteps.body: Follow PushChain on X and join the Push Chain Discord , then complete verification inside the portal. This unlocks the quest board and referral link.

sourcedSteps.title: Claim testnet PC from the faucet
sourcedSteps.body: Click the wallet icon inside the portal to open the faucet and claim 1 free PC token. The faucet resets every 6 hours, so grab it a few times a day to keep enough gas for the onchain quests.

sourcedSteps.title: Complete the universal app challenges
sourcedSteps.body: Work through the quests attached to each app in the weekly rotation: play, or predict, depending on the app. These challenges are the main XP source in Season 3.

sourcedSteps.title: Check in daily
sourcedSteps.body: Hit the daily check-in whenever you open the portal. Streaks stack a bonus on top of the base reward, and a missed day resets it.

sourcedSteps.title: Use the daily spin
sourcedSteps.body: The Spin 2 Win wheel pays out Rare Passes, testnet $PC, and other rewards once per day. It takes a few seconds and is one of the few pass sources outside of leveling.

sourcedSteps.title: Collect Rare Passes
sourcedSteps.body: Stack as many Rare Passes as you can through level ups and spins. All passes get burned at TGE for a shot at a Shiny Pass, and the bigger your stash, the better your odds.

sourcedSteps.title: Invite friends
sourcedSteps.body: Share your referral link from the portal. You earn 16% of the points your invites generate and another 8% from the people they invite. Extra invite slots unlock as your referrals reach level 7, so help your invites stay active.

sourcedSteps.title: Climb the leaderboard
sourcedSteps.body: Leaderboards are live and track actual network usage. A higher rank heading into TGE positions you for a larger share of the season allocation.

guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Log In With Your X Account
guide.description: Go to the REP app and sign in with X. This becomes the anchor identity for your profile, and REP reads public metrics like follower quality to seed your first badges.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect Your Wallets
guide.description: Open your profile and bind your wallets. REP supports roughly five addresses per account, EVM and others. Use the wallets with the deepest history, since an empty wallet produces no achievements. You only sign a message to prove ownership, with no approvals or transfers.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Link Your Other Social Accounts
guide.description: Add Telegram, Farcaster, Discord, and any other supported platform from the profile page. Each one widens the pool of achievements you qualify for.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim Your Achievements
guide.description: Open the achievements list and claim every badge you qualify for. Values range from a few hundred REP points for social milestones up to 3,000 for top-percentile DeFi activity. Some claims charge a small on-chain fee, so keep a little of the relevant gas token in your connected wallet. You can buy it on Bybit and withdraw it directly, or move assets you already hold with the widget below to bridge
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Set Your Remoji Rank
guide.description: Ranks run across seven tiers, from pilgrim at the bottom to the top 0.5% band. Once your badges are claimed, set the rank emoji on your REP profile and on Telegram, where it acts as the signal other users read before connecting with you.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Browse Matches and Join Rooms
guide.description: Open the Matches section to see communities your reputation qualifies you for. Some rooms ask for an email address. Join the ones relevant to your activity rather than every room on the list.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Share Your Social Graph Invite Link
guide.description: Grab your personal invite link from the Social Graph section and share it. Invites are weighted by who accepts them, so a handful of active wallets beats a long list of empty ones.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Create Your SoSoValue Account
guide.description: Visit SoSoValue and sign up with email or a wallet. The same account works across the web platform and the iOS and Android apps.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Earn EXP Through Platform Tasks
guide.description: Open the EXP page from the badge in the top-right of the SoSoValue interface and complete Starter Pack and daily tasks. These include exploring dashboards, learning about SSI indexes, the daily check-in, and inviting friends with your referral link. This Season 3 path is free and does not require any capital.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect a Wallet and Add ValueChain
guide.description: Connect MetaMask or another Web3 wallet, then add the ValueChain network so you can hold SSI tokens and trade on SoDEX. Fund the wallet with USDC, which you can buy on Binance if you need it, or bridge directly using the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a n
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Buy SSI Index Tokens
guide.description: Open the SSI page and buy one of the index products based on the sector exposure you want: MAG7.ssi: a large-cap basket index DEFI.ssi: a DeFi sector index MEME.ssi: a meme sector index USSI: a USD-denominated index
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Stake Your SSI Tokens
guide.description: Go to the Stake to Earn tab and stake your index tokens. Holding earns a 3x point multiplier, but staking raises it to 15x, so staked positions earn far more Loyalty Points. There is a 14-day cooldown before you can withdraw staked tokens.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Deposit into the SoDEX Vault
guide.description: Deposit sMAG7.ssi or MAG7.ssi into the SoDEX Vault to earn passive SoPoints on top of your staking rewards, adding the extra APR layer with no extra trading.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade on SoDEX to Earn SoPoints
guide.description: Head to SoDEX and trade spot or perpetual pairs. Trading volume is the most effective way to earn SoPoints, and the dynamic weighting model rewards steady, organic activity over one-time spikes.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Stake SOSO and Invite Friends
guide.description: Stake SOSO in the Reward tab to boost your Loyalty Points. Once you pass 1,000 USDC in SoDEX volume, you can unlock a referral code that pays 10% fee rebates and 25% of your invitees’ points with no cap.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim Your SOSO Rewards
guide.description: Rewards are distributed by smart contract after each epoch ends. Return to the Reward page when the claim window opens, connect your wallet, and claim your SOSO within the 90-day window.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Sign Up on the Sweep Airdrop Page
guide.description: Visit the Sweep airdrop page and create an account using Google, X, email, or a connected wallet. Registration is free and takes under a minute.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Verify Your Account
guide.description: Complete email, and KYC verification from your dashboard. Each verification level awards XP on its own, and a verified account keeps you eligible for the final distribution.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete the Social Media Tasks
guide.description: Work through the social tasks in the campaign dashboard, such as following Sweep’s official channels. Finished tasks credit XP automatically, though some rewards take a short while to appear.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Play Sweepbird Every Day
guide.description: Open Sweepbird and play at least one round daily. A single game keeps your streak alive, and streak milestones unlock Bird Tier badges that add XP to your account permanently. You can also earn additional XP by finishing in the Top 100 of the Sweepbird leaderboard, which refreshes daily.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Invite Friends With Your Referral Link
guide.description: Grab the referral link from your dashboard and share it. Invites are repeatable, so each friend who signs up and participates keeps adding to your total.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Make Eligible Purchases (Optional)
guide.description: Qualifying purchases can also award XP. Purchase-related tasks will become available once Phase 3 of the fairlaunch is active. Check the campaign dashboard for updates and eligibility details.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check Back for New Tasks and Events
guide.description: Sweep adds campaign tasks and special events while the airdrop runs. A quick daily look at the dashboard catches new XP sources early.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Build Your Incentive Passport
guide.description: Install a Sui wallet first. Slush and Nabox both work across TBook’s products, and you will want a little SUI for gas. Then open the TBook engagement portal , connect the wallet, and link your X account and Discord. The Passport is the container every score writes into, so an incomplete profile caps everything downstream.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Mint Your WISE Credit Score
guide.description: Mint your WISE Credit Score from the same portal. It reads your linked wallets and accounts and grades you across four dimensions. Mint early, because the score accrues history and a profile built weeks before a snapshot outweighs one created that day.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete Campaigns and Collect SBTs
guide.description: Work through the active campaigns on the portal. Each issues a soulbound token on completion, and SBT holdings are a named eligibility category. Types rotate weekly: Prediction campaigns, where you commit to an outcome and mint an SBT on resolution X Spaces attendance drops and Engagement Basecamp quests Partner project campaigns run through TBook for other protocols
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Fund Your Wallet with USDC
guide.description: The vault takes USDC on Sui. Bybit lists USDC and supports direct Sui withdrawals, which skips bridging entirely. Already holding USDC elsewhere? Move it across with the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Deposit into the rcUSD Vault
guide.description: Open the TBook Vault and pick the rcUSD Vault, which routes deposits into the R25 Protocol. Deposits run from 1 USDC to 1 million with no fee, settlement is T+1, and you receive shares that appreciate as yield accrues rather than paying out separately. APY has recently sat above 8%.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Mint a Bookies NFT
guide.description: Bookies NFTs live on Sui at TBook’s NFT page. Holding one raises your Wealth Score and puts you in the airdrop category reserved for early supporters, the most direct eligibility upgrade here.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Visit the Tread fi Terminal
guide.description: Go to the Tread fi website and open the app to begin.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Sign In or Create an Account
guide.description: Register with your email address or by connecting a crypto wallet. Existing users should sign in with the same method used during Season 1 so their points and allocation carry over.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect Your Exchange Accounts
guide.description: Open the wallet section from the icon in the top right of the dashboard and link your trading venues: Connect your Hyperliquid account Optionally add Aster , Pacifica , Bybit, or an EVM wallet Trading to earn points requires real capital on your connected venues. If you need to fund an account, you can buy assets on Binance or using the below widget. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check Your Season 1 Points
guide.description: If you traded during Season 1, open the points dashboard to review your accrued points. These points feed into your retroactive TREAD allocation, which becomes claimable once the Foundation confirms the snapshot and opens distribution.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade to Earn Season 1.5 Points
guide.description: Route trades through the terminal to accumulate Season 1.5 points, distributed pro-rata by your adjusted trading volume across connected exchanges.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Generate Your Referral Link
guide.description: Create a referral link from the referral section to earn a share of the volume generated by traders you invite.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Track Distribution Announcements
guide.description: Watch the airdrop claims list and the official Tread channels so you know the moment eligibility and the TREAD claim go live.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Set Up a Custom Agent
guide.description: Open the Agents section Configure settings and select which exchange you want the agent to trade on Go to New Agent Use an agent built by Tread or create your own
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Install the Vangrid App
guide.description: Download the Vangrid App on Android, or open the browser capture tool if you are on iOS. Allow camera and location access, since captures without location data cannot be verified.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Record a Capture That Meets the Spec
guide.description: Film a location a robot would realistically need to cross. Vangrid accepts: Sidewalks and pedestrian paths Stairs and stairwells Alleys and service lanes Public squares and plazas Skip roads, crowds of people, and private indoor spaces. Recording requirements: Hold the phone vertically at chest level, using both hands Walk at a steady pace and pan smoothly from side to side Record 30 to 60 seconds
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Enter an Invite Code and Upload
guide.description: Uploads are gated behind an invite code. Enter GRID-01 before uploading. Uploading daily adds a 50-point bonus, with further bonuses at 5, 10, and 50 total videos.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Loyalty Hub
guide.description: Open the Vangrid Loyalty Hub and connect an EVM wallet. Your first login credits PTC on its own.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete Loyalty Hub Quests
guide.description: Work through the quest list: follow Vangrid on X, join the Discord, connect LinkedIn, engage with posts, and publish weekly X posts. Reach Discord through the Hub quest link rather than a forwarded invite. No legitimate verification asks you to sign a wallet transaction, so close any page that does.

sourcedSteps.title: Install the Vangrid App
sourcedSteps.body: Download the Vangrid App on Android, or open the browser capture tool if you are on iOS. Allow camera and location access, since captures without location data cannot be verified.

sourcedSteps.title: Record a Capture That Meets the Spec
sourcedSteps.body: Film a location a robot would realistically need to cross. Vangrid accepts: Sidewalks and pedestrian paths Stairs and stairwells Alleys and service lanes Public squares and plazas Skip roads, crowds of people, and private indoor spaces. Recording requirements: Hold the phone vertically at chest level, using both hands Walk at a steady pace and pan smoothly from side to side Record 30 to 60 seconds in daylight

guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Wager Predict Testnet
guide.description: Visit the Wager Predict app and connect MetaMask or any WalletConnect wallet. Grab free tBNB for gas by clicking the faucet button.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim 10,000 Testnet USDC
guide.description: Open the in-app faucet and claim. The claim sends 10,000 test USDC straight to your wallet.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Approve USDC and Place Your First Trade
guide.description: Pick a live market, choose YES or NO, and enter an amount. Your first trade needs a one-time approval transaction before the buy confirms. Fees are 2% per trade, and selling works like buying, so you can exit any position up to one hour before expiry.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade Across Markets and Test Leverage
guide.description: Spread bets across categories rather than parking everything in one market. Then try a leveraged position; 5x and 10x tiers unlock on higher-volume markets. Liquidations use a 30-minute average of the odds rather than spot, so one erratic trade will not instantly close you out.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Create Your Own Markets
guide.description: Head to the market creation page and write a clearly worded question with an unambiguous resolution source. The protocol seeds the liquidity, so you take no market-making risk, and you collect 0.5% of every trade on your market for life.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Stake in the LP Vault
guide.description: Deposit test USDC into the LP vault, which lends to leveraged traders and pays depositors a cut of their fees. Lock tiers of Flex, 90, 180, and 365 days carry point multipliers of 1x, 2x, 4x, and 8x, and the multiplier only applies while the lock is active. Withdrawals sit through a 7-day cooldown, even on Flex.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Climb the Season 01 Leaderboard
guide.description: Track your P&L on the leaderboard, work through the onboarding achievements, and collect badges as you trade. Share your referral link from the dashboard to bring in other traders.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Visit WheelX and connect your wallet
guide.description: Go to WheelX and connect an EVM wallet like MetaMask or Rabby. First-time connections receive a 1,000 XP newcomer bonus automatically. At the current rate, the base bonus is worth about $0.36.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Fund your wallet with ETH or stablecoins
guide.description: You need real assets to bridge and swap. Grab ETH, USDT, or USDC from Bybit and withdraw to your wallet, or move funds you already hold onto a supported chain using the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Complete the social quests
guide.description: Open the WheelX quest page and follow WheelX on X, join the Discord server, and join the Telegram channel. Each task pays 20 XP once. These are the cheapest points on the board, so clear them first.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Bridge and swap regularly
guide.description: This is the core XP source. Each completed bridge or swap earns XP based on transaction value, and it stacks with your booster multiplier. Skip Solana-side swaps for now, since those transactions do not count toward XP yet.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Deploy a smart contract
guide.description: WheelX offers a contract deployment tool that pays a flat 50 XP per mainnet deployment. Testnet deployments earn nothing, so use a cheap chain like Base or Ink to keep gas costs below the reward value.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check in daily with onchain GM
guide.description: The GM feature pays a fixed 3 XP per day for an onchain check-in. It is small, but it keeps your address active and adds up over a long farming window.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Refer friends and redeem dividends
guide.description: Share your referral link from the rewards page. You earn XP 1:1 with everything your referees make from swaps, bridges, deployments, and GM check-ins. Once your redeemable balance clears the $5 minimum, withdraw your USDT dividends on Base.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Visit the Worldie Early Access Page
guide.description: Go to the Worldie early access page and click “Join early.” Sign in with your X account or Google.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Join the Worldie Discord
guide.description: Use the Discord icon on the early access page to join the official Worldie Discord. The +400 World Points bonus is added once you’re in the server.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect Your X Account and Wallet
guide.description: Open the “Get your invite” panel and connect X (if you signed in with Google) along with a wallet. Connecting both locks your referral link. There is no deposit step.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Claim Your Invite Link
guide.description: Claim your personal invite link from the same panel. Worldie ties the link to your name.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Share Your Link
guide.description: Send the link to friends and communities that would use a social trading app. A referral only counts after the invited user signs up and connects both X and a wallet, so mention both requirements when you share it.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Track Your Rank on the Leaderboard
guide.description: Click “See the board” to check your World Points and position. Global, Friends, This Week, and All Time tabs let you compare yourself against everyone or just your own network.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Sign Up at Yakkamon
guide.description: Create your account with an email address on the Yakkamon pre-registration page . No wallet is needed at this stage. Enter the referral code YAKKA-52UCFU during sign-up.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Nurture Your Egg Daily
guide.description: Tap your egg three times each day for +6 points. Daily streaks add bonuses, and a missed day resets the streak.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect Discord and X
guide.description: Link your Discord and X accounts for +10 points each. Helpful posts in the Discord earn extra points through community reactions, and the weekly share quest pays +20 points per week once X is connected.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Link and Verify a Wallet
guide.description: Connect a wallet and sign a message to prove ownership for +10 points. A verified wallet is also required for the free mint whitelist, so complete this well before October 1, 2026.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Refer Friends
guide.description: Each verified friend who joins earns you +30 points. Your first five referrals count instantly; after that, invitees must verify Discord and X and reach 100 points before the bonus lands. Multi-accounting gets filtered out on review.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Mint the Free Monster NFT on October 1
guide.description: Join the free mint of 10,000 Monster NFTs on Ronin using your verified wallet. It costs nothing beyond a small gas fee, is limited to one mint per trainer, and minting adds points to your leaderboard total.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Mint Your Yakkamon NFT
guide.description: Check which waves your Ronin wallet qualifies for on the whitelist checker Deposit 5 $FLOWER if you’re minting in Wave 2 or Wave 4 (see the $FLOWER deposit guide ) Connect your Ronin wallet to the Ronin Launchpad when your wave opens and mint, keeping some RON for gas
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: 参与前准备
guide.description: 准备一个专用的独立空投钱包，并确认设备环境安全。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。
guide.done_when: 已创建独立钱包，并记录好助记词（仅离线保存，不输入任何网站）。

guide.title: 进入官方活动页面
guide.description: 点击下方已验证的官方链接。核对浏览器地址栏域名与官网一致后再继续。
guide.done_when: 页面成功打开，且域名与官方一致。

guide.title: 连接钱包
guide.description: 在官方页面连接上一步准备的独立钱包。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。
guide.done_when: 页面右上角显示钱包地址。

guide.title: 完成社交任务
guide.description: 按官方要求关注 X、加入 Discord 等，并在官方页面完成验证。
guide.done_when: 所有社交任务显示为已完成 / Verified。

guide.title: 完成核心链上任务
guide.description: 按官方说明完成测试网、积分或交互任务。每一步操作前确认合约地址来源官方。
guide.done_when: 任务状态在官方页面显示为已完成。

guide.title: 检查任务状态
guide.description: 返回官方活动页面，确认所有任务与积分都已正确记录。
guide.done_when: 所有任务均显示已完成，且积分已计入。

guide.title: 参与前准备
guide.description: 准备一个专用的独立空投钱包，并确认设备环境安全。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。
guide.done_when: 已创建独立钱包，并记录好助记词（仅离线保存，不输入任何网站）。

guide.title: 进入官方活动页面
guide.description: 点击下方已验证的官方链接。核对浏览器地址栏域名与官网一致后再继续。
guide.done_when: 页面成功打开，且域名与官方一致。

guide.title: 连接钱包
guide.description: 在官方页面连接上一步准备的独立钱包。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。
guide.done_when: 页面右上角显示钱包地址。

guide.title: 完成社交任务
guide.description: 按官方要求关注 X、加入 Discord 等，并在官方页面完成验证。
guide.done_when: 所有社交任务显示为已完成 / Verified。

guide.title: 完成核心链上任务
guide.description: 按官方说明完成测试网、积分或交互任务。每一步操作前确认合约地址来源官方。
guide.done_when: 任务状态在官方页面显示为已完成。

guide.title: 检查任务状态
guide.description: 返回官方活动页面，确认所有任务与积分都已正确记录。
guide.done_when: 所有任务均显示已完成，且积分已计入。

guide.title: 连接钱包

guide.title: 完成社交任务

guide.title: 完成核心链上任务

guide.done_when: 任务状态在官方页面显示为已完成。

guide.title: 检查任务状态

guide.done_when: 所有任务均显示已完成，且积分已计入。

guide.title: 参与前准备
guide.description: 准备一个专用的独立空投钱包，并确认设备环境安全。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。
guide.done_when: 已创建独立钱包，并记录好助记词（仅离线保存，不输入任何网站）。

guide.title: 进入官方活动页面
guide.description: 点击下方已验证的官方链接。核对浏览器地址栏域名与官网一致后再继续。
guide.done_when: 页面成功打开，且域名与官方一致。

guide.title: 连接钱包
guide.description: 在官方页面连接上一步准备的独立钱包。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。
guide.done_when: 页面右上角显示钱包地址。

guide.title: 完成核心链上任务
guide.description: 按官方说明完成测试网、积分或交互任务。每一步操作前确认合约地址来源官方。
guide.done_when: 任务状态在官方页面显示为已完成。

guide.title: 检查任务状态
guide.description: 返回官方活动页面，确认所有任务与积分都已正确记录。
guide.done_when: 所有任务均显示已完成，且积分已计入。

guide.title: 参与前准备
guide.description: 准备一个专用的独立空投钱包，并确认设备环境安全。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。
guide.done_when: 已创建独立钱包，并记录好助记词（仅离线保存，不输入任何网站）。

guide.title: 进入官方活动页面
guide.description: 点击下方已验证的官方链接。核对浏览器地址栏域名与官网一致后再继续。
guide.done_when: 页面成功打开，且域名与官方一致。

guide.title: 连接钱包
guide.description: 在官方页面连接上一步准备的独立钱包。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。
guide.done_when: 页面右上角显示钱包地址。

guide.title: 完成核心链上任务
guide.description: 按官方说明完成测试网、积分或交互任务。每一步操作前确认合约地址来源官方。
guide.done_when: 任务状态在官方页面显示为已完成。

guide.title: 检查任务状态
guide.description: 返回官方活动页面，确认所有任务与积分都已正确记录。
guide.done_when: 所有任务均显示已完成，且积分已计入。

guide.title: 参与前准备
guide.description: 准备一个专用的独立空投钱包，并确认设备环境安全。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。
guide.done_when: 已创建独立钱包，并记录好助记词（仅离线保存，不输入任何网站）。

guide.title: 进入官方活动页面
guide.description: 点击下方已验证的官方链接。核对浏览器地址栏域名与官网一致后再继续。
guide.done_when: 页面成功打开，且域名与官方一致。

guide.title: 连接钱包
guide.description: 在官方页面连接上一步准备的独立钱包。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。
guide.done_when: 页面右上角显示钱包地址。

guide.title: 完成核心链上任务
guide.description: 按官方说明完成测试网、积分或交互任务。每一步操作前确认合约地址来源官方。
guide.done_when: 任务状态在官方页面显示为已完成。

guide.title: 检查任务状态
guide.description: 返回官方活动页面，确认所有任务与积分都已正确记录。
guide.done_when: 所有任务均显示已完成，且积分已计入。

guide.title: 参与前准备
guide.description: 准备一个专用的独立空投钱包，并确认设备环境安全。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。
guide.done_when: 已创建独立钱包，并记录好助记词（仅离线保存，不输入任何网站）。

guide.title: 进入官方活动页面
guide.description: 点击下方已验证的官方链接。核对浏览器地址栏域名与官网一致后再继续。
guide.done_when: 页面成功打开，且域名与官方一致。

guide.title: 连接钱包
guide.description: 在官方页面连接上一步准备的独立钱包。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。
guide.done_when: 页面右上角显示钱包地址。

guide.title: 完成核心链上任务
guide.description: 按官方说明完成测试网、积分或交互任务。每一步操作前确认合约地址来源官方。
guide.done_when: 任务状态在官方页面显示为已完成。

guide.title: 检查任务状态
guide.description: 返回官方活动页面，确认所有任务与积分都已正确记录。
guide.done_when: 所有任务均显示已完成，且积分已计入。

guide.title: 参与前准备
guide.description: 准备一个专用的独立空投钱包，并确认设备环境安全。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。
guide.done_when: 已创建独立钱包，并记录好助记词（仅离线保存，不输入任何网站）。

guide.title: 进入官方活动页面
guide.description: 点击下方已验证的官方链接。核对浏览器地址栏域名与官网一致后再继续。
guide.done_when: 页面成功打开，且域名与官方一致。

guide.title: 连接钱包
guide.description: 在官方页面连接上一步准备的独立钱包。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。
guide.done_when: 页面右上角显示钱包地址。

guide.title: 完成社交任务
guide.description: 按官方要求关注 X、加入 Discord 等，并在官方页面完成验证。
guide.done_when: 所有社交任务显示为已完成 / Verified。

guide.title: 完成核心链上任务
guide.description: 按官方说明完成测试网、积分或交互任务。每一步操作前确认合约地址来源官方。
guide.done_when: 任务状态在官方页面显示为已完成。

guide.title: 检查任务状态
guide.description: 返回官方活动页面，确认所有任务与积分都已正确记录。
guide.done_when: 所有任务均显示已完成，且积分已计入。
